title: Why Nvidia's Board Changed Its Mind in Days #Shorts
description:
Nvidia's board first said it did not plan to bring Jensen Huang back. Days later it voted unanimously to reinstate him as CEO (23 Nov 2026). Reported factors: a falling stock (seven days down), the S&P 500 sliding into a correction, investor concern about the interim leadership, and President Trump, who told CNBC "I made the deal". Nvidia also set up a new national security and export control oversight panel.
